text:
maya (Design): Quick sync — trying a compact left nav that groups Models + Deployments. Label thought: 'Workloads' or 'Workspaces'?
sam (Frontend): Workloads = explicit; Workspaces = softer. Either ok but breadcrumbs must mirror the label exactly.

jonah (PM): Routing question: prefer canonical deep links like /workspace/:id/model/:modelId. Also support ?view=compact for shareable links.

sam (Frontend): Agreed. Router-wise /workspace/:id/model/:modelId is simpler. Fallback: missing modelId -> list view; invalid workspace -> redirect to /workspace with toast.

kevin (A11y): A11y nits: last breadcrumb needs aria-current; separators should be aria-hidden. Skiplink copy should read "Skip to main navigation". When view toggles via query param announce via aria-live polite ("Navigation collapsed").

maya (Design): UX tweak: swap the '+' affordance for a chevron + accessible label (Expand/Collapse). Keep 44px hit target on mobile and make the whole row clickable.

sam (Frontend): Implementation plan: group button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; preserve ?navMode=compact override for demos. Router will normalize paths and pass view/navMode through.

jonah (PM): Support requested that permalinks always open the same console view, so use query params not cookies. e.g. /workspace/123/model/xyz?view=compact.

kevin (A11y): Truncation: use visual ellipses plus aria-label with full name; do not rely on title/tooltips. After breadcrumb navigation, move focus to main header (tabindex=-1) so keyboard users land in context.

maya (Design): Microcopy: breadcrumb separator currently is ›; mark separators aria-hidden and pick a thinner glyph so it isn't visually prominent. Also double-check contrast for breadcrumbs (AA 4.5:1).

navbot (deploy-bot): branch nav-compact-experiments deployed to staging: staging.redwood.internal/nav-test (build 2026.03.22-9).

maya (Design): Action list: 1) validate skiplink target, 2) test aria-live announcements, 3) confirm breadcrumb contrast, 4) verify permalink behavior. Please try staging and drop quick notes.

sam (Frontend): Will test and post quick fixes.

jonah (PM): I'll run a hallway test on icon-only vs icon+mini-label and decide label by EOD Friday.

kevin (A11y): I'll run screen reader pass and share notes.

maya (Design): If no objections we'll ship with 'Workloads' and the a11y/copy fixes. :sparkles:
